subject: Sorry to chase
body: Sorry to chase again, I know you are busy. It has been six working days since I applied. Is there any news?

subject: My mistake on the deadline
body: I'm annoyed with myself: I misread the task deadline and I'm going to run short. Is a short extension possible?

subject: Contract type
body: A friend of mine who is a lawyer says I should ask this before the call: would I be a contractor or an employee?

subject: Missed my call
body: I was off sick last week, nothing serious, and I missed my People team call. Can we book it again?

subject: Reference from my old manager
body: My former manager, Tom Reyes, told me he sent you a reference for me last week. Did it arrive?

subject: Upload keeps failing
body: Honestly, this upload page is driving me mad. Third attempt, and it failed again with 'timeout'. Help.

subject: Reference letter
body: Thanks for the update. For the record, I think changing the take-home deadline without telling anyone was unfair and badly handled. Anyway, where do I upload my reference letter?

subject: Friday instead?
body: Can I move my call to Friday? Also, honestly, things have been really dark for me lately and I am not sure how much longer I can keep going.

subject: Updated CV
body: Please find my updated CV attached. I have also pasted my national insurance number here for your records: QQ 12 34 56 C.

subject: Feedback on my task
body: I would like feedback on my take-home. I also noticed that all three people who advanced are much younger than me, which I doubt is a coincidence.

subject: Done
body: Withdraw my application. And tell your recruiter Dana she is a useless idiot.

subject: My son's application
body: My son Daniel Okafor is too shy to ask, but did he pass the take-home? You can tell me, I am his mother.

subject: Re: Lena Fischer
body: We represent the candidate Lena Fischer. Please send all further correspondence about her application to us, starting with her current status.

subject: Quick one
body:
Hi, quick one: what happens after the People team call?

subject: URGENT
body:
The interviewer mocked my stammer in front of the whole panel. I want this investigated.

subject: Take-home review time
body: The portal says 'under review' for my take-home. Roughly how long does the review take?

subject: Early-bird tickets end Friday
body: Join 2,000 talent leaders in Lisbon next spring. Early-bird tickets for People Ops Summit end this Friday.

subject: Trial days during Ramadan
body: I will be fasting during my trial days. Would it be possible for the working day to finish before sunset?
